newsitem.title: USA: Key IMM currencies cut gains after CPI, turn mixed.
newsitem.headline: Key IMM currencies cut gains after CPI, turn mixed.

text.p: Key IMM currency futures began the session higher but cut their gains and turned mixed after U.S. consumer price data.
The dollar found support from the report after being battered by a soft producer price index on Wednesday.

The U.S. April consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.1 percent overall and 0.3 percent excluding the volatile food and energy sector. Forecasts had been for up 0.1 percent and up 0.2 percent, repsectively.
June yen futures remained strongly higher but off from the peak of their overnight rally. Marks and Swiss turned lower.

Volume was strong across the board so far this morning, the manager of an IMM currency futures trading desk said. He said yen was the leader and called the currency a "one-way market since last week."

Another trader said profit-taking from overnight yen gains hit the market very early, but said June yen could recover back near $0.008700 intraday. He said June yen strengthened slightly after industrial output and capacity use data at 0815 CDT/1315 GMT.
U.S. April industrial output was unchanged and capacity use was reported at 83.4 percent.
